content.title: How to watch Diamondbacks vs. Phillies: TV channel and streaming options for April 10
content.text: The Philadelphia Phillies host the Arizona Diamondbacks to open a three-game series at Citizens Bank Park, with first pitch at 6:40 p.m. ET on Friday. Jesus Luzardo (1-1, 4.97 ERA) gets the start for the Phillies, who are 6-6 this season and fourth in the NL East. Mike Soroka (2-0, 0.90 ERA) is the expected starter for the Diamondbacks, who are 7-6 and second in the NL West.How to watch Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Philadelphia Phillies Venue: Citizens Bank Park Time: 6:40 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: NBCS-PH+ and Dbacks.TV Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has a 13.5% strikeout rate and a 13.5% walk rate in 52 plate appearances, and he has scored five total runs. In 54 plate appearances, Trea Turner has slashed .260/.315/.340 this season. He has hit no long balls and driven in three runs with a strikeout rate of 20.4% and a walk rate of 7.4%. He has one stolen base on one attempt. He has come around to score nine times. Corbin Carroll has hit two home runs this season. He has also tallied 11 RBIs (11th in MLB) and has scored nine runs. In 49 plate appearances, he has recorded a .333 BA, .408 OBP and .690 SLG with a 12.2% walk rate and a 20.4% strikeout rate. He has been effective on the base paths, recording one steal on one attempt. In 52 plate appearances, Geraldo Perdomo has hit one long ball, tallied four RBIs and scored five runs. He is batting .171/.294/.293 and has posted a 3.8% strikeout rate and a 15.4% walk rate. Perdomo has recorded two steals on four attempts.
